import json
from pathlib import Path
from makemarket.provenance import file_sha256, receipt

training_path=Path('results/training/qwen35_dagger.json')
guard_path=Path('results/training/qwen35_dagger_memory.json')
training=json.loads(training_path.read_text())
guard=json.loads(guard_path.read_text())
assert training['status']=='validation_plateau' and guard['status']=='completed'
assert training['completed_iterations']==599 and training['optimizer_updates']==299
root=Path('train/runs/qwen3.5-4b-dagger')
initial=Path('train/runs/qwen3.5-4b-sft/adapters.safetensors')
selected=root/'adapters.safetensors'
assert training['best_step']==0
assert file_sha256(initial)==file_sha256(selected)==training['best_adapter_sha256']
last=sorted(root.glob('[0-9]*_adapters.safetensors'))[-1]
assert file_sha256(last)!=file_sha256(initial)
record={'provenance':receipt({'purpose':'retain completed DAgger continuation, unchanged selected weights and separate fixed last checkpoint'},training['model_revision']),
        'source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'status':'validation_plateau',
        'training_result':str(training_path),'memory_result':str(guard_path),
        'input_sha256':{str(p):file_sha256(p) for p in (training_path,guard_path,initial,selected,last)},
        'training_wall_seconds':training['wall_seconds'],'guard_wall_seconds':guard['wall_seconds'],
        'sampled_footprint_peak_bytes_approx':guard['sampled_footprint_peak_bytes_approx'],
        'stopping_validation_callback':599,'optimizer_updates_completed':299,
        'best_step':0,'best_validation_loss':training['best_validation_loss'],'validation':training['validation'],
        'selected_adapter_identical_to_sft':True,'last_numbered_checkpoint':str(last),
        'last_checkpoint_differs_from_sft':True,
        'interpretation':'No improvement under the registered teacher-loss selection rule. This is not evidence that the trained last checkpoint has unchanged policy PnL; its separately registered 100/game validation remains pending. Counts use callback 599, not a fabricated 600 completed microbatches.'}
Path('results/training/qwen35_dagger_completion.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:record[k] for k in ('status','training_wall_seconds','selected_adapter_identical_to_sft','last_numbered_checkpoint')}))
interpretation: No improvement under the registered teacher-loss selection rule. This is not evidence that the trained last checkpoint has unchanged policy PnL; its separately registered 100/game validation remains pending. Counts use callback 599, not a fabricated 600 completed microbatches.
